user.title: Samsung TV Notify
user.description: The HA Notify app must be installed on the TV. Setup launches it once, so the TV shows its start screen for a few seconds.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TV.
data_description.port: Port of the HA Notify service on the TV (8099 unless you changed the app).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV or start the notification service. Make sure the TV is on.
error.app_not_installed: The HA Notify app is not installed on the TV.

data_description.auto_start: If the service is not running when a notification is sent, launch the HA Notify app first. The TV shows the app's start screen for a few seconds.
data_description.display_time: How long the banner stays on screen.

send_failed.message: Could not show the notification on the TV: {error}

start_failed.message: Could not start the notification service on the TV: {error}
